data.name: SourceOne
data.comment: {0}: number of selected rows; {1}: table; {2}: source connection

data.name: SourceOther
data.comment: {0}: number of selected rows; {1}: table; {2}: source connection

data.name: SourceTransaction
data.value: This workspace has uncommitted changes: the copy takes the rows as it sees them.

data.name: TargetHeading
data.comment: Section heading: where the rows go

data.name: NoTarget
data.value: No other connection is open. Open the target connection first.

data.name: ChildrenHeading
data.comment: Section heading: rows that reference the copied rows

data.name: ChildrenHint
data.value: Rows that reference the copied rows, along the chosen relationships, up to {0} levels deep. Parents always come along.

data.name: Via
data.comment: {0}: name of the relationship, e.g. FK_AUFTRAG_KUNDE

data.name: ReadAgain
data.comment: Button: the choice changed since the rows were read

data.name: ChoiceChanged
data.value: The choice changed since the rows were read.

data.name: ColumnNew
data.comment: Column heading: rows the target does not have

data.name: ColumnExisting
data.comment: Column heading: rows the target has already

data.name: ColumnConflict
data.comment: Column heading: what happens to a row the target has already

data.name: UpdateNeedsKey
data.value: Updating needs the target's primary key.

data.name: ParentsHeading
data.comment: Section heading: rows the copied rows reference

data.name: ParentsHint
data.value: Rows the copied rows reference come along, up the whole chain – otherwise the relationship would be violated in the target. Switch one off if those rows exist there already (master data, say); the check looks for them in the target.

data.name: CheckHeading
data.comment: Section heading: errors, warnings and hints of the copy

data.name: CopyTitle
data.value: Writes into the target workspace's transaction as one action – undo there with ↶, commit as usual.

data.name: Copied
data.comment: {0}: description of the copy, e.g. 'Copy from DEV: 57 rows'; {1}: target connection and workspace

data.name: ExistingDiffer
data.comment: {0}: rows the target has; {1}: of them with other values

data.name: ExistingDifferTitle
data.value: Same key, other values in the target – possibly other records

data.name: StrandRowsTitle
data.value: Rows along this relationship in the last read

data.name: TargetLockedHint
data.value: {0} is locked: unlock the workspace there to copy into it.

data.name: PreviewAsDiagramTitle
data.value: The tables of the copy as a diagram: parents to the left, in the order the rows are inserted

data.name: DiagramRowsOne
data.comment: {0}: rows; {1}: new rows; {2}: rows the target has

data.name: DiagramRowsOther
data.comment: {0}: rows; {1}: new rows; {2}: rows the target has

data.name: DiagramConflictDiffering
data.comment: {0}: conflict mode, e.g. Skip; {1}: existing rows with other values
